Selects v0.9.3 via rc.1 verification plus the additive rc.2 note, flags that v0.9.3 is also absent, gives the #v0.9.3 install command conditional on maintainer tag push, and offers a conditional reachable-SHA alternative without inventing one or upgrading DSH.
Proposes --atomic --follow-tags plus an explicit refs/tags push per mirror and an ls-remote verification gate that fails on a missing tag; grounded in the branch-only script.
